profile.headline: Senior Java Engineer | Cloud-Native Microservices | AWS | AI-Assisted Development
profile.geoLocationName: Monmouth Junction, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
•	Programming expert in Java with 15+ years of experience in software design and development
•	Extensive experience across the full SDLC including application analysis, architecture, development, and deployment using Agile methodologies
•	Strong expertise in Java 8+, Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, MVC, Cloud, Data) and Microservices architecture
•	3+ years of experience building microservices architecture for high performing REST APIs
•	Hands on exposure to cloud architecture based Microservices on CI/CD environment
•	Secured REST APIs with encryption mechanisms like OAuth2 and JWT
•	Adept in Java 8 with lambda function, method reference & streams for easy and efficient coding 
•	Good understanding of object-oriented design and usage of commonly used design patterns
•	Proficient in persistence technologies like JPA, Hibernate and JDBC
•	Strong working knowledge of many RDBMS databases using SQL and PL/SQL
•	Worked with DevOps team to deploy & auto-scale APIs using Jenkins & Docker containerization
•	Hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate coding, refactoring, test generation, documentation, and problem-solving while maintaining code quality and security standards
•	Experience with cloud-based applications using range of AWS services
•	Hands on experience building message/event driven architecture using Kafka
•	Created unit tests to ensure code quality using Junit, Mockito and SonarQube
•	Hands on experience to measure and monitor performance bottlenecks using New Relic and Dynatrace
•	Ability to interpret and troubleshoot critical technical issues using server logs
•	Experience working with source control tools such as SVN and GIT
•	Proven ability to mentor, lead, and guide teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture
•	Cross team collaboration and project management skills to get the work done
•	Excellent problem solving, analytical and interpersonal skills
•	Innovative and creative to foster ideas towards a result-oriented direction
•	Driven by new challenges and adapt easily to business and cultural environments
